dashboard.noMatch: No trades match these filters. Clear or adjust Filters to see more results.

dashboard.widgetTradeWinHint: Winning trades divided by all closed trades, including breakevens.
dashboard.widgetProfitFactorHint: Gross profit ÷ gross loss. Above 1 means the wins outweigh the losses.
dashboard.widgetDayWinHint: Green trading days ÷ all trading days in the selected range.
dashboard.widgetAvgWinLossHint: Average winning trade ÷ average losing trade. The bar shows the two to scale.
dashboard.avgWinVsLossAria: Average win vs average loss, to scale
dashboard.edgeScoreHint: A 0–100 score combining win rate, profit factor, average win/loss, drawdown, recovery, and consistency. Requires at least five closed trades.
dashboard.edgeNeedsTrades: Needs 5+ closed trades. The formula is open —
dashboard.cumulativePnlHint: Running total of net profit and loss over the selected period. The drawdown bars below show declines from the running equity peak.
dashboard.dailyPnlHint: Net profit or loss for each trading day. Bars above zero are profitable; bars below zero are losses.
dashboard.maxDrawdownHint: Largest peak-to-trough drop of the cumulative P&L curve.
dashboard.streaksHint: Current run of consecutive wins (W) or losses (L), with the best and worst runs.
dashboard.expectancyHint: Average net P&L per closed trade: what one more trade is worth on your numbers.
dashboard.tagStopLosses: tag stop-losses to unlock R multiples
dashboard.avgDurationHint: Average time from first entry fill to final exit.
dashboard.bestWorstDayHint: Highest and lowest single-day net P&L in the selected range.
dashboard.tradeTimeHint: Trades grouped by their opening hour. The upper chart shows net P&L; the lower chart shows trade count.
dashboard.emptyBody: Connect a broker for automatic sync, upload a statement from 10+ platforms (including your TradeZella export), or add trades manually.
dashboard.demoHint: Demo data lands in its own account; delete it anytime under Accounts.

calendar.closedTradesFees: {count, plural, one {# closed trade} other {# closed trades}} · Net of fees

calendar.noClosedInView: No closed trades in this view

calendar.mixedCurrencies: These trades use {currencies}. Select accounts with one currency to compare monetary performance; no exchange-rate conversion is applied.
calendar.netPnlHint: Sum of net P&L for closed trades in this month and filter selection. Includes fees. No currency conversion.

calendar.avgDailyHint: Net P&L divided by trading days. Days without closed trades are excluded; break-even trading days are included.
calendar.winRateHint: Winning closed trades divided by all closed trades, including break-even trades. Uses your journal's configured break-even rule.
calendar.totalClosedHint: Counts completed trades whose closing day falls in the visible month and selected date range, with all other filters applied.

calendar.eachAverageOwn: Each average uses only its own group.
calendar.dayConsistencyHint: Share of trading days with strictly positive net P&L. This is a profitable-day rate, not a risk-adjusted score or a prediction. Flat days stay in the denominator.

calendar.byWeekdayMeta: Closing-day net P&L · {currency} · Select a row
calendar.smallSample: Small sample: {count, plural, one {# trading day} other {# trading days}}. Weekday results and consistency describe this selection only.

reports.cellValuesNote: Cell values are net P&L in {currency}.
reports.noClosedTradesMatch: No closed trades match these filters.
reports.multiCurrency: These accounts use different currencies ({currencies}). Select accounts with the same currency in Filters to compare monetary results.
reports.exportSummaryLine: Closed trades: {trades} | Net P&L: {pnl} | Win rate: {winRate}
reports.exportGroupLine: {label}: {trades} trades | P&L {pnl} | Win {winRate} | Planned {plannedR}R | Realized {realizedR}R | Volume {volume} | Holding time {duration}
reports.breakdownFootnote: Closed trades only. Dates use the closing day; weekday and entry time use the opening time in {timeZone}. Volume is total entry quantity. R uses weighted entry and total entry quantity; missing or invalid risk inputs are excluded from R averages. Derivatives require a configured multiplier for realized R. Multiple tags or mistakes can place a trade in more than one group, so those group totals can overlap.
reports.compareIntro: Each group has its own filters. Compare strategies, accounts, periods, or trade characteristics. Groups may overlap.
reports.compareCurrencyAlert: Select accounts with the same currency in both groups. Currency conversion is not applied.
reports.metricWinRateR: Win rate: {winRate} | Planned R: {plannedR} | Realized R: {realizedR}
reports.annotateToUnlock: Annotate trades to unlock this breakdown.
reports.overviewFootnote: Weekday and hour use trade opening times. Overview trade counts include open positions; win rates use closed trades. Holding time requires a closed trade. Tags and mistakes can overlap. By symbol shows the top 20 by net P&L; Breakdowns includes every symbol and additional metrics for closed trades.
reports.askHint: Uses the selected accounts and journal filters. Changing filters clears the answer.
reports.askPlaceholder: Why do my Monday shorts keep failing?
reports.suggestion2: Which weekday should I stop trading?
reports.suggestion3: Am I better at longs or shorts?
reports.maeMfeSummary: {have} of {total} closed trades have saved estimates. Estimated gross excursions exclude fees; MAE is shown as a positive adverse amount. Missing values are excluded from plots, never counted as zero.
reports.calculateMissingHelp: Loads {resolution} candles for this selection using each trade’s recorded symbol. This uses your provider allowance and may take several minutes. For custom symbols or a specific CSV dataset, load and save estimates from the individual trade.
reports.basisConfirm: I confirm these symbols, price adjustments and quote currencies match the fills and account currency ({currencies}).
reports.oneCurrencyRequired: Select accounts with one currency to calculate estimates together.
reports.connectMarketData: Connect a market data provider in Settings
reports.estimateResult: {stopped, select, true {Stopped. } other {}}{saved} estimates saved · {failed} unavailable · {remaining} not processed.
reports.trendsMeta: {count} closed trades · Active account and filters · Closing order · {timeZone}{currencyPart}
reports.noClosedInSelection: No closed trades in this selection
reports.noClosedInSelectionHint: Change the date range or filters to explore your trading history. Open positions are excluded.
reports.trendsMultiCurrency: These trades use different currencies ({currencies}). Win rate is available; select accounts with one currency to compare P&L and largest trades. No currency conversion is applied.
reports.last20Closed: Last 20 closed trades at each point
reports.needMoreTrades: {count, plural, one {# more closed trade is} other {# more closed trades are}} needed for the first full 20-trade window.
reports.chartAppearsAt27: Latest window available. A line chart appears at 27 closed trades, when there are 8 full windows to compare.
reports.largestWinLossHint: Individual closed trades, after fees—not daily totals. Uses your journal’s win/loss classification.
reports.noWinningTrades: No winning trades in this selection.
reports.noLosingTrades: No losing trades in this selection.
reports.windowCaption: Each row covers 20 trades ending at the linked trade. Dates use {timeZone}.
reports.trendsFootnote: Only trades within your selection are used; earlier trades are not borrowed to fill a window. Rolling windows overlap and describe recent results—not a forecast. Small samples can change sharply.
reports.explorerMeta: Compare individual trades, not group averages · Active account and filters · {timeZone}
reports.grossExcursionNote: Gross excursion estimates; net P&L after fees
reports.explorerNoClosedHint: Change the date range or filters to explore your history. Open positions are excluded.
reports.explorerMultiCurrency: These trades use different currencies ({currencies}). Select accounts with one currency for monetary axes, or use Duration and Realized R to compare risk-normalized outcomes. No currency conversion is applied.
reports.tradesExcluded: {count} trades excluded: {realizedNote}{excursionNote}Both axes require valid values and timestamps.
reports.realizedRExcludeNote: realized R requires a valid planned stop-loss and any required contract multiplier;
reports.excursionExcludeNote: MAE/MFE require saved, current market-data estimates.
reports.realizedRExplain: R = net P&L ÷ planned risk from your stop-loss. Uses weighted entry and total entry quantity; it does not measure maximum intratrade risk.
reports.selectPointHint: Select a point to inspect its trade. Overlapping points remain individually accessible in the table.
reports.noDataForAxes: No trades have the data required for these axes. Try another axis or adjust your filters.
reports.fewerThan8: Fewer than 8 comparable trades. Review the exact values below, or widen your filters to reveal a useful scatter plot.
reports.smallSample: Small sample: treat apparent patterns cautiously until more trades are available.
reports.tableCaption: All {count} comparable trades, newest close first. Each link opens the original trade.
reports.explorerFootnote: Duration is elapsed time from first entry to final exit, including overnight hours. Entry time uses the journal timezone; midnight neighbors appear at opposite ends of that axis. Patterns describe this selection, not causation or a recommended holding time.

import.statementTimezoneHelp: Choose the timezone used by your broker's statement. Timestamps with an explicit offset keep that offset. Your journal displays times in {displayTimeZone}.
import.invalidTimezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone, such as Europe/Helsinki.
import.chooseAiFile: Choose a statement for AI parsing
import.chooseFile: Choose a CSV / HTML / XML statement
import.aiFileHint: CSV, TSV, HTML, XML, TXT or PDF. Your file stays local until you preview with AI.
import.autoDetected: Auto-detected: {formats} — anything else via column mapping.
import.mappingUnrecognized: Format not recognized — map your columns (nothing is guessed silently):
import.positionIdentityHelp: For Open/Close Long/Short rows, map source position IDs, execution IDs or sequence numbers when available. Columns named Position ID, Execution ID, Fill ID and Sequence are recognized automatically. An order ID is not an execution ID.
import.ninjatraderRecoveryHint: Recovering an older NinjaTrader import or correcting its timezone? Import the complete history into a new journal account, then compare totals. Keep the original account and its reviews until you have verified the recovery.
import.correctingImportHint: Correcting a previous import? Remove the affected trades before importing again with a different timezone to avoid duplicates. Back up your data first.
import.aiReviewedConfirm: I compared all extracted executions with my statement, including the account, quantities, prices, fees and timestamps. Import this preview.
import.enableAiForPdf: Enable AI parsing to upload a PDF statement.
import.aiUploadTooLarge: AI uploads must be 8 MB or smaller.
import.aiFileTypes: Choose a CSV, TSV, HTML, XML, TXT or PDF file. Export spreadsheets as CSV first.
import.aiTextTooLarge: Use a smaller export: AI text parsing supports up to 150,000 characters.
import.importedAlert: Imported {inserted} executions ({duplicates} duplicates skipped, {corrected} fee corrections).{skippedNote}
import.brokerTitle: Connect a broker (read-only keys, stored encrypted on YOUR machine)
import.ibkrTimezoneError: Could not load the import timezone. Refresh and try again.
import.ibkrTimezoneReady: Statement timezone: {zone}. Used for Flex timestamps without an offset. Change it in Settings → Journal before connecting.
import.notesPlaceholder: Your setup, why you took the trade, or what you learned…
import.notesHint: Markdown supported. Notes are saved with the trade; existing notes are kept when adding to an open position.
import.manualFootnote: Dates and times use your device’s timezone. Executions matching an open position on {symbol} are stitched into round trips automatically ({legs} legs so far).
import.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the trade. Try again.
import.reviewNinjaHint: Keep each source account separate inside your selected journal account. Review the result before saving.
import.chooseSource: Choose the source this file belongs to
import.renameSourceHint: If an account or connection was renamed, select its existing source. Choose a new source only for a genuinely different account.
import.completeHistoryConfirm: This export includes every execution for each listed source contract between its first and last timestamp. It is not a partial selection of repeated fills.
import.approveFeeCorrections: Apply these commission corrections to the existing executions and recalculate P&L.
import.reviewComplete: Review complete. Import will save this result; if the file, settings or journal changes, another review is required.
import.aiHelp: If you're having issues importing a file, AI parsing can help. The journal supports many broker exports, but column names and statement layouts can change. Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or LM Studio can interpret unfamiliar formats and extract trades for your review. Check quantities, prices, fees and dates against your statement before importing. Your file is sent to your chosen provider using your API key; cloud provider usage charges apply.
import.leaveBlankKey: Leave blank to use your configured key
import.keysSessionOnlyBefore: Keys entered here are used for this upload session only. Manage saved keys in
import.fileSentOnPreview: Your file will be sent to {provider} when you select Preview with AI. Provider charges apply. Review the extracted trades before importing.
import.aiLimits: CSV, TSV, HTML, XML, TXT and PDF · Up to 200 executions per preview. PDFs up to 8 MB; text exports up to 150,000 characters. For spreadsheets, export as CSV first. PDF support depends on your selected model.

propFirms.accountDescription: Keep each evaluation, reset attempt and funding phase as its own record. Account size is nominal capital, not money you spent.
propFirms.archiveDescription: Archiving hides the account from the active list. Its cash history remains in returns. You can restore it later.
propFirms.awaitingHint: All dates · Excluded from received cash
propFirms.chooseCurrencyCompare: Choose a currency in Filters to compare spending and payouts.
propFirms.chooseCurrencyPlot: Choose a currency to plot cash returns.
propFirms.comparisonHint: Refunds reduce your net cost. Hover a month for refunds and the final net amount.
propFirms.csvTooLarge: Use a CSV up to 2 MB / 1,000 rows.
propFirms.dateOrderError: The start date must be on or before the end date.
propFirms.demoHint: Simulated records · Read-only · Nothing is saved
propFirms.detailedBreakdownsHint: Net cash trend, firm returns, expense categories, account progress, renewals and monthly records
propFirms.emptyBody: Add the firm and attempt you want to track, then record fees and actual payouts. You can also log shared firm costs before linking an account. No firm, fee schedule or payout rules are preloaded.
propFirms.emptyCashHistory: Record spending or a payout receipt to build your cash history.
propFirms.emptyComparison: Record an expense or a payout receipt to start your comparison.
propFirms.emptyTitle: Start with an account or an expense
propFirms.filtersDatesHint: Dates apply to cash received or paid. Account history and pending requests cover all dates.
propFirms.heading: Spending & payouts
propFirms.howCurrency: Amounts use each currency’s minor units. Currencies are never converted or combined automatically. Your firm’s actual approval, payout rules and bank statement remain authoritative.
propFirms.howHistory: Past attempts, breached accounts and archived accounts stay in cash returns. Shared firm costs are included in firm totals but are not silently allocated to individual accounts.
propFirms.howNet: Net cash return = actual payout receipts − payout reversals + expense refunds − spending. Net spend = spending − refunds. ROI = net cash return ÷ net spend; it is unavailable when net spend is zero or negative.
propFirms.howScope: Requests and reminders never move money. This tracker does not place trades, connect banks, infer payout eligibility, or change journal trading P&L. JSON exports in Settings include these records and their audit history; copy the data directory to preserve attachment files too.
propFirms.importDescription: Import settled expenses, refunds and net payouts. Preview validates every row; an import is all-or-nothing and repeated stable IDs are skipped.
propFirms.importHint: Use kind expense, refund or payout; date YYYY-MM-DD; positive amount in currency units. A payout amount is cash already received after splits and fees. Payouts need account_id from an account’s Details. A refund’s expense_id references its original CSV row ID. Put expenses before their refunds. This is not a broker statement importer.
propFirms.ledgerHint: Expenses and refunds use cash dates; payout rows use request dates. Export cash CSV for individual settlement dates. Payout requests do not count as income.
propFirms.linkAccountsHint: Link accounts to journal trades from account details. Funding sizes are descriptive and never counted as your cash investment.
propFirms.linkedExpense: Linked expense: {id}. Refunds reduce costs and are shown separately from payout income.
propFirms.moneySpentHint: All fees, subscriptions and other costs
propFirms.multiCurrencyHint: Currencies are never added together. Choose one above for charts and detailed totals.
propFirms.netCashHint: Starts at zero for the selected period. Payouts + refunds − expenses − reversals.
propFirms.noCashMovements: No cash movements in this selection.
propFirms.noExpenses: No recorded expenses in this selection.
propFirms.passRateDetail: {passed} passed / {total} passed or breached evaluation phases. Active and voluntarily closed phases are excluded; this is not a whole-challenge success rate.
propFirms.payoutDescription: A request is not income. Record actual bank receipts separately, including partial payments. This does not request a payout from your firm.
propFirms.payoutsHint: Open requests always remain visible. Completed, rejected and cancelled requests use the request-date filter. Expected amounts are after your share and withheld fees; actual amounts come only from receipts.
propFirms.pendingTracked: Pending requests are tracked separately below.
propFirms.privacyBanner: Privacy mode hides amounts, charts and financial details. Turn it off to edit records or export cash data.
propFirms.receiptDescription: Record the actual net amount credited or returned in {currency}. If your bank converted currencies, use the statement's original-currency amount; this tracker does not invent an exchange rate.
propFirms.receiptHint: Keep the request open for partial payments. Once the final payment arrives, edit the payout status to Completed; a difference from the expected amount remains visible.
propFirms.renewalHint: A reminder only. Record an expense when charged; nothing is charged or added automatically.
propFirms.renewalsHint: Reminders do not create expenses or charge your card. Update the next date after reviewing a renewal.
propFirms.searchPlaceholder: Search firm, account, reference or status
propFirms.spendingBreakdownHint: Gross spending by category. Refunds appear separately in the summary.
propFirms.spendingDescription: Record cash that actually changed hands. Include taxes and fees in the amount paid. Do not duplicate trading commissions already included elsewhere.
propFirms.splitHint: If your amount is already after the firm split, enter 100% and only fees still to be deducted. Never deduct the split twice.
propFirms.subtitle: See what you paid, what came back, and your net result.
propFirms.voidDescription: Voided records stay in the audit trail and are excluded from cash totals. They can be restored. Voiding a payout also excludes its receipts.

settingsTrading.breakevenHelp: Closed trades within this net P&L range count as breakeven. Actual P&L is unchanged. Percentage mode uses entry price × total entry quantity × contract multiplier; configure multipliers for derivatives first.
settingsTrading.defaultFeesHelp: Applied to new fills with a zero fee, including explicit zeroes. Nonzero imported fees and existing fills are kept. The first matching rule wins.
settingsTrading.stopTargetHelp: Distances from weighted entry, adjusted for long or short direction. Applied only when a new trade is first created. The first matching rule wins.
settingsTrading.multipliersHelp: Use the exact symbol shown on your imported trades, including the contract month when present.
settingsTrading.multipliersRecalc: Saving multipliers recalculates existing trade P&L from fills and preserves annotations.
settingsTrading.multiplierLineError: Check line {line}: enter a unique symbol and a positive multiplier, such as ESU6=50.

settingsCurrency.title: Currency conversion
settingsCurrency.intro: Combine accounts using your own saved exchange rates. Works entirely offline.
settingsCurrency.enable: Convert dashboard and calendar to the reporting currency
settingsCurrency.reportingHelp: Changing the reporting currency clears the draft rates. Enter new rates before saving.
settingsCurrency.ratesHelp: These are fixed baseline rates, not live market rates. Changing saved rates recalculates all dashboard and calendar history, including starting balances and drawdown. Original account records, trade details and reports keep their account currencies.
settingsCurrency.saved: Conversion settings saved. Dashboard and calendar figures now use these settings.
settingsCurrency.missingRates: Enter a rate for {codes} before enabling conversion.

settingsMarketData.title: Market data
settingsMarketData.intro: Connect historical prices for estimated MAE/MFE and candle replay on closed trades. Vela renders the charts. No data source is enabled or selected by default. Choose a connection or upload your own candles. Market data connections are separate from broker sync and AI.
settingsMarketData.credentialsPrivacy: Credentials are encrypted locally and used only by the server for market data. Saved secrets are never returned to the browser or included in journal exports.
settingsMarketData.envIncomplete: Complete all required fields in the server environment.
settingsMarketData.msgTestPublic: Public endpoint reachable. No API key or paid data plan is required. Candle availability depends on the pair, date range and public API limits.
settingsMarketData.msgTestPrivate: Connection verified. Instrument coverage depends on your provider access.
settingsMarketData.msgSaved: Credentials saved. Test the connection to verify access.

csv.title: Market data CSV
csv.intro: Upload one instrument and candle resolution per file, up to 5 MB / 50,000 rows. Required columns: time, open, high, low, close. Volume is optional. Time is the bar open: ISO-8601 with timezone, Unix seconds or milliseconds. Daily bars must start at 00:00 UTC. These are market candles, separate from trade execution imports.
csv.symbolPlaceholder: Exact symbol used in your file
csv.msgImported: Market candles imported. Choose Market data CSV on a trade or in Reports.
csv.msgRemoved: Dataset and its saved estimates removed.
csv.fileTooLarge: Use a CSV smaller than 5 MB.

settingsAi.title: AI (bring your own key)
settingsAi.intro: Use Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or LM Studio for recaps, trade critiques, and “ask your journal”. Your key is encrypted at rest. AI requests go from your server directly to the provider you select.
settingsAi.modelHelp: Use a text model available to your provider account. Each provider keeps its own model and key.
settingsAi.modelHelpLmStudio: Match the model identifier shown in LM Studio for the loaded model.
settingsAi.lmStudioBaseEnv: Using LM_STUDIO_BASE_URL from the server environment. Change or remove that variable on the server.
settingsAi.lmStudioBaseHelp: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (usually ends with /v1). Start LM Studio’s local server first. If the journal runs in Docker, use http://host.docker.internal:1234/v1 — 127.0.0.1 points at the container, not your Mac.
settingsAi.keyEnv: Using {envKey} from the server environment. Change or remove that variable on the server to update the key.
settingsAi.keyKeep: Leave blank to keep your saved key, or enter a replacement.
settingsAi.keyAdd: Add your API key, then save to use this provider.

progress.intro: Build a repeatable trading day. Routines are tracked independently of trade filters and profit.
progress.heatmapHelp: Brighter squares mean a higher completion rate. Grey means no scheduled routines. Click a day to review it. New routines start today.

missed.intro: Record setups you watched but did not take. These observations never enter your trade count, P&L, or win rate.
missed.exportObservation: Observation only: no executed trade or actual P&L.

marketData.title: Market data & replay
marketData.intro: Load candles for this trade to use replay. Enable the checkbox to also calculate and save monetary MAE/MFE estimates for Reports.
marketData.connectProvider: Connect a market data provider in Settings
marketData.connectSuffix: to use historical replay and estimates.
marketData.optionsUnsupported: Option contract history is not supported yet.

marketData.confirmHint: Unchecked: load candles and replay only. Checked: also calculate monetary estimates and save valid results to Reports. Missing or mismatched data stays unavailable.
marketData.savedHint: Previously saved MAE/MFE estimates are shown below. Loading candles without the checkbox keeps those saved estimates; it does not calculate new ones.
marketData.noCandles: No candles were returned for this instrument and trade period. Check the symbol, dataset and plan coverage.
marketData.privacyHidden: Historical prices and excursion amounts are hidden in privacy mode.

marketData.candlesThrough: {count} / {total} candles · Through {through} (UTC). Candles are revealed at bar close; this is not a tick-by-tick simulation.
marketData.chartUpdateFailed: The replay chart could not be updated.
marketData.chartRenderFailed: The historical chart could not be rendered.
